issues.message: 正方形与数学结果“平方”合并后各仅一个例句，搭配及近义表达也混用。须分义，各补足两个例句，并把 perfect square 的数论用法移到平方义。
two blocks from the square 中 square 指广场，blocks 才表示街区。原译文、例句注释及北美街区义的泛化说明缺乏依据。
仅说长宽相等或四边相等不足以定义正方形，须包含直角条件，并说明立体物体的方形轮廓用法。
把框架与墙面的关系直接译成“成直角”容易误导；修齐边缘也未突出 square 的直角要求。须改用明确的木工例句和搭配说明。
结清与协调两义各只有一个例句，square A with B 又混淆了付款对象、协调对象和相符依据。须给结清义补足例句，并另行讲清相符及使相符的句法。
面积单位应教 square metres，不能在此使用 squared metres。还须区分 squared 的屈折变化与 squarely 的派生构词。
缺少常用面积单位用法与棋盘、网格中的方格义；直角尺、直角形容词、结清状态、相符动词及画方格动词等也应在补充义中交代。
Three squared is nine 中 squared 对应平方运算，不应绑定正方形图形义。
词源材料支持字形来源关系，但未逐项支持原稿为各阶段补写的释义。须把可靠的历史关系保留在 summary，删除会被画成带释义顺序链的 stages。
实际来源中没有 Oxford 页面正文，不能把它作为已使用的词义与发音依据。须删除该来源，改引已取得的英语词条；该词条未涵盖的专业语言知识补充不冒充词典出处。
英式词尾 r 的说明宜明确限定常见非卷舌口音，并交代后接元音时的连读；原 IPA 采用的学习词典记音方式可保留。
原责任归属例句本身正确，但 squarely 的“完全、明确地”与所绑定的空间方向义不够对应。改为正中目标的例句。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对原词条及取得的英语词典部分所列主要义。补丁后，正方形、平方结果、广场、方形形容词、面积单位、方格、直角调整、平方运算、结清和正对副词等核心内容均有至少两个例句；较专业或较少见的功能放入补充义。删除街区义的无依据地域断言，补充面积表达对比，并保留可证实的词源关系。未取得的 Oxford 页面不再引用；部分补充用法依据专业语言知识，sourceIds 留空。范围为主要义项教学，未穷举所有短语和行业用法。

patches.valueJson: {"id":"square-n-math","title":"名词：平方","meaning":"一个数与自身相乘所得的结果。","usageNote":"常说 the square of a number；这里 square 是运算结果的名称，不是动词。","examples":[{"id":"sq-n2","senseId":"square-n-math","en":"The square of five is twenty-five.","zh":"五的平方是二十五。","note":"the square of five 指五乘以五所得的结果。"},{"id":"sq-n-math2","senseId":"square-n-math","en":"For his homework, Ben calculated the square of twelve.","zh":"本在做作业时算出了十二的平方。","note":"calculated the square of twelve 表示计算十二的平方。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"the square of a number","zh":"一个数的平方","note":"of 后接被平方的数，如 the square of seven。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"calculate the square of a number","zh":"计算一个数的平方","note":"square 在此是 calculate 的名词宾语。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a perfect square","zh":"完全平方数","note":"在整数运算中，指某个整数的平方，如 9、16、25。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"the second power of a number","zh":"一个数的二次幂","note":"与该数的平方相同，是较正式的数学说法。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"the square root of a number","zh":"一个数的平方根","note":"是相关的反向运算概念，不是普通词义上的反义词。"}],"similarNote":"平方就是二次幂；不要与乘以二混淆。","contrastingNote":"取非负平方根可在非负数范围内反向还原平方运算；平方本身会丢失正负号。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-square-etymology"]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"square-n-grid","title":"名词：方格；棋盘格","meaning":"棋盘、网格等划分出的一格，通常呈正方形。","usageNote":"是可数名词；说某个棋盘格常用 on a square，移动几格可直接用数词加 squares。","examples":[{"id":"sq-grid1","senseId":"square-n-grid","en":"Move your piece two squares to the left.","zh":"把你的棋子向左移两格。","note":"two squares 表示棋盘上的两格距离。"},{"id":"sq-grid2","senseId":"square-n-grid","en":"The children coloured each square on the grid a different colour.","zh":"孩子们把网格中的每一格涂成不同的颜色。","note":"each square 指网格中的每一个方格。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"move a piece two squares","zh":"把棋子移动两格","note":"squares 在此用于计数棋盘上的格子。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a square on the chessboard","zh":"棋盘上的一格","note":"on the chessboard 说明方格所在的位置。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"cell","zh":"表格或网格中的单元格","note":"在表格、网格语境可接近 square，但 cell 不要求是正方形，通常不用来称呼国际象棋棋盘格。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"square 强调方格或棋盘格；cell 常用于表格、电子表格等。","contrastingNote":"方格是具体区域名称，没有通用反义词。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-square-etymology"]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"square-adj-area","title":"形容词：平方的（面积单位）","meaning":"放在 metre、foot 等长度单位前，构成面积单位；一平方米是边长一米的正方形的面积。","usageNote":"通常把 square 放在单位前：twelve square metres。square 不随数量变复数；单位按数量变化，如 one square metre、two square metres。metre 是英式拼写，meter 是美式拼写。","examples":[{"id":"sq-area1","senseId":"square-adj-area","en":"Our kitchen is twelve square metres.","zh":"我们厨房的面积是十二平方米。","note":"twelve square metres 表示面积，不表示每边十二米。"},{"id":"sq-area2","senseId":"square-adj-area","en":"The label says this tin of paint covers eight square metres.","zh":"标签上说，这罐油漆可以涂刷八平方米的面积。","note":"square metres 用于说明油漆可覆盖的面积。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"数字 + square + 面积单位中的长度单位","zh":"……平方单位","note":"如 five square metres、twenty square feet；平方米不要写成 squared metres。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a square metre","zh":"一平方米","note":"面积单位；不能据此判断实际场地的形状。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"square feet","zh":"平方英尺","note":"foot 的复数是 feet，square 保持不变。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"m²","zh":"平方米的符号","note":"12 m² 通常读作 twelve square metres。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"square metres 与 square meters 只是英美拼写不同，面积单位相同。","contrastingNote":"面积单位没有通用反义词；metres 表示长度，与 square metres 的量纲不同。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-square-etymology"]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"square-adj-right-angle","title":"形容词：成直角的；方正的","meaning":"角为九十度，或物体的有关边角符合直角要求。","note":"在木工等语境中，be square 描述状态；square something 描述校正过程。out of square 表示没有达到直角要求。","example":{"id":"sq-right-angle1","senseId":"square-adj-right-angle","en":"The frame looks straight, but its corners aren't square.","zh":"这个框架看着摆得很正，但各个角并不是直角。","note":"square 作表语，说明角度；看起来摆正不等于角度正确。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-square-etymology"]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"square-adj-settled","title":"形容词：结清的；互不相欠的","meaning":"双方的钱款已经结算清楚，不再有欠款。","note":"口语中常说 be square 或 be square with someone。仍欠钱可说 still owe someone money；be square 也能表示方形，须看语境。","example":{"id":"sq-settled1","senseId":"square-adj-settled","en":"Here's the ten pounds I owed you; we're square now.","zh":"这是我欠你的十英镑，现在我们互不相欠了。","note":"we're square 描述还款后的状态，不是动作。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"square-v-consistent","title":"不及物动词：与……相符","meaning":"说法、数字或事实彼此吻合，没有矛盾。","note":"句型是 A squares with B，常用于否定句或疑问句。近义表达是 be consistent with；与事实矛盾可说 contradict the facts。","example":{"id":"sq-consistent1","senseId":"square-v-consistent","en":"His account of the accident doesn't square with the video.","zh":"他对这起事故的叙述与录像内容不符。","note":"account 是主语，with 引出核对依据；这里没有付款的意思。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: {"id":"square-v-reconcile","title":"及物动词：使相符；协调妥当","meaning":"设法使两件事相互吻合，或把一项安排与有关的人协调好。","note":"square A with B 可接两组需要核对的内容，近义表达是 reconcile A with B。B 为人时，如 square the schedule with the coach，可表示与教练协调日程、取得认可。square a problem up 还可表示把问题解决妥当；是否涉及付款要看上下文。","example":{"id":"sq-reconcile1","senseId":"square-v-reconcile","en":"I can't square these figures with the bank statement.","zh":"我无法把这些数字与银行对账单核对一致。","note":"these figures 是宾语，with 引出要与之核对的另一组信息；不同于不及物的 A squares with B。"},"sourceIds":[]}
